def sum_list(xs):

tasks.name: median
tasks.prompt:
def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list; average the middle two if even."""
tasks.solution:
s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    h = n // 2
    if n % 2:
        return s[h]
    return (s[h - 1] + s[h]) / 2

tasks.name: fib

def fib(n):
    """Return the n-th Fibonacci number, with fib(0) == 0 and fib(1) == 1."""
tasks.solution:

tasks.name: unique
tasks.prompt:
def unique(xs):
    """Return the values of xs once each, in first-seen order."""
tasks.solution:
seen = set()
    out = []
    for x in xs:
        if x not in seen:
            seen.add(x)
            out.append(x)
    return out

tasks.name: rle
tasks.prompt:
def rle(s):
    """Run-length encode s as a list of (character, count) pairs."""
tasks.solution:
out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        j = i
        while j < len(s) and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        out.append((s[i], j - i))
        i = j
    return out

tasks.name: collatz_len
tasks.prompt:
def collatz_len(n):
    """Return how many terms the Collatz sequence takes to reach 1, counting n and 1."""
tasks.solution:
count = 1
    while n != 1:
        n = n // 2 if n % 2 == 0 else 3 * n + 1
        count += 1
    return count
